description: This file exports types, functions, and constants related to real-time transcription providers and sessions, acting as an interface to other modules and plugins involved in real-time transcription functionalities.

methods.name: canonicalizeRealtimeTranscriptionProviderId
methods.description: Normalizes or standardizes the format of a transcription provider ID.

methods.name: getRealtimeTranscriptionProvider
methods.description: Retrieves a specific real-time transcription provider based on provided ID.

methods.name: listRealtimeTranscriptionProviders
methods.description: Lists all available real-time transcription providers.

methods.name: normalizeRealtimeTranscriptionProviderId
methods.description: Converts provider ID into a normalized form for consistent identification.
